01 Services

Automate, build and support

Whether it’s a task your team repeats every week, a tool you’re missing or a system that needs care, we’ll help you find the right starting point.

Business automation & applied AI

We connect your software so information flows automatically between tools. Where AI adds real value, we put proven models to work or develop and test a custom model for your needs.

  • Triage incoming enquiries and draft replies for your team to approve.
  • Send form submissions straight to your job tracker, with follow-up reminders set.
  • Extract key information from documents for researchers to review.

Ongoing IT support

Reliable, ongoing care for the systems your business depends on, including every tool and automation we build for you.

  • Prompt troubleshooting when something stops working.
  • Maintenance and updates that keep pace as your business grows.

Custom software systems

One shared place for your team to manage jobs, records and approvals, built around the way your business already works.

  • Track every job from first request to completion.
  • Streamline approvals using the steps your team already follows.

Websites & apps

Websites that help customers find you, explore what you offer and take action, plus simple mobile tools your staff can use anywhere.

  • Online quote requests and appointment booking.
  • Mobile-friendly checklists for staff in the field.

Business analysis & reporting

We identify the numbers that matter most to your decisions, then bring them together in clear reports and dashboards.

  • Automated weekly summaries of jobs or sales.
  • Open requests and overdue work, visible at a glance.

Social media marketing

We research your market and audience, then build a social media strategy that supports your business goals.

  • A content plan covering what to post, where and how often.
  • Day-to-day management of your Facebook, Instagram and X accounts.

02 How it works

A simple path from first conversation to lasting results

We start by understanding how your team works today, then focus on the changes that will make the biggest difference.

  1. 01

    Understand your workflow

    We map the steps, tools and handovers involved, then agree with you on what to automate, connect or build.

  2. 02

    Build and test together

    We trial the new setup with real-world examples, so your team can confirm it fits the way they work before it goes live.

  3. 03

    Support you long term

    We agree on a clear support arrangement, so you always know how to get help with a fault, update or change.
